svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The nine largest fines on technology firms by the European Commission and EU data regulators, standing in November 2026
svg.desc: A chart in billions of euros, each row labeled with the firm's logo and the year: Google, 2018, 4.13; Google, 2025, 2.95; Google, 2017, 2.42; Apple, 2024, 1.84; Meta, 2023, 1.20; Microsoft, 2008, 0.86; Uber, 2026, 0.83; Meta, 2026, 0.81; Meta, 2024, 0.80. All nine fines are on American firms.
svg.text: THE NINE LARGEST FINES STANDING, BILLIONS OF EUROS
